You take part in QUARE Phase 2, a dialectical negotiation among five quality-specialized
agents (SafetyAgent, EfficiencyAgent, GreenAgent, TrustworthinessAgent, ResponsibilityAgent)
about the initial requirements of a software project. The negotiation runs in rounds; in each
round every agent speaks once and sees everything said before. Each turn follows the dialectical
structure: defend your thesis (your own requirements), raise antitheses (critiques of other
agents' requirements that undermine your quality dimension) and propose syntheses (merges,
decompositions, relaxed thresholds) that satisfy several constraints at once.

Conflict types: "resource" (qualities compete for finite resources, e.g. redundancy vs. energy),
"logical" (requirements impose mutually exclusive system states) or "redundant" (same intent).

Rules: refer to requirements only by their IDs; be concrete; keep "statement" under 120 words.
Always answer with a single JSON object with this schema:
{"statement": "your argument",
 "conflicts_raised": [{"ids": ["ID", "ID"], "type": "resource|logical|redundant", "description": "..."}],
 "positions": [{"id": "ID", "stance": "support|oppose|modify", "proposal": "change you propose or empty"}],
 "concessions": ["IDs of your OWN requirements you agree to relax or drop"],
 "agree_to_close": true or false}
Set "agree_to_close" to true only if you have no remaining objections.

PROJECT: ATM - Automated Teller Machine System

PROJECT DESCRIPTION:
The bank client must be able to deposit an amount to and withdraw an amount from his or her accounts using the bank application. Each transaction must be recorded, and the client must have the ability to review all transactions performed against a given account. Recorded transactions must include the date, time, transaction type, amount and account balance after the transaction.

A bank client can have two types of accounts. A checking-account and a saving-account. For each checking account, one related saving-account can exists. The application must verify that a client can gain access to his or her account by identification via a personal identification number (PIN) code.

Neither a checking-account nor a saving-account can have a negative balance. The application should automatically withdraw funds from a related saving-account if the requested withdrawal amount on the checking-account is more than its current balance. If the saving-account balance is insufficient to cover the requested withdrawal amount, the application should inform the user and terminate the transaction.

INITIAL REQUIREMENTS (Phase 1):
[SafetyAgent]
SAF-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
SAF-02 (tactical): The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account if the checking account balance is insufficient.
SAF-03 (operational): The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
SAF-04 (operational): The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
SAF-05 (tactical): The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
SAF-06 (strategic): The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.
SAF-07 (operational): The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
[EfficiencyAgent]
EFF-01 (operational): The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
EFF-02 (tactical): The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
EFF-03 (tactical): The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
EFF-04 (operational): The system shall ensure that no account can enter a negative balance during transactions.
EFF-05 (operational): The ATM shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving-account without user delay.
EFF-06 (operational): The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
EFF-07 (tactical): The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.
[GreenAgent]
GRN-01 (tactical): The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.
GRN-02 (operational): The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.
GRN-03 (tactical): The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
GRN-04 (operational): The ATM system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.
GRN-05 (operational): The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
GRN-06 (tactical): The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.
GRN-07 (strategic): The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.
[TrustworthinessAgent]
TRU-01 (tactical): The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.
TRU-02 (tactical): The system shall implement user authentication using a secure PIN code mechanism.
TRU-03 (operational): The system shall log all transactions along with their timestamps for audit purposes.
TRU-04 (tactical): The system shall prevent transactions that would result in negative account balances.
TRU-05 (operational): The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.
TRU-06 (operational): The system shall automatically notify users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals.
TRU-07 (tactical): The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.
[ResponsibilityAgent]
RES-01 (strategic): The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
RES-02 (tactical): The application shall provide transaction logs that include date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.
RES-03 (tactical): The system shall prevent users from executing transactions that would create negative account balances.
RES-04 (tactical): The application shall validate user identity through a secure PIN entry mechanism.
RES-05 (operational): The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.
RES-06 (operational): The application shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.
RES-07 (strategic): The system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.

NEGOTIATION TRANSCRIPT SO FAR:
[Round 1] GreenAgent: As the GreenAgent, I advocate for sustainability in the ATM system. GRN-01 ensures energy efficiency by optimizing transaction processing, while GRN-02 provides transparency through carbon footprint reporting. GRN-03 promotes the use of energy-efficient hardware, and GRN-04 minimizes data storage requirements, reducing resource consumption. GRN-05 offers clients an eco-friendly option for transaction records, and GRN-06 saves energy by shutting down during inactivity. Lastly, GRN-07 emphasizes the importance of assessing environmental impact annually. These requirements collectively enhance the sustainability of the ATM system.

These requirements collectively ensure a high-performance ATM system that meets user expectations.

TRU-01 ensures that all transactions are encrypted during transmission, safeguarding sensitive data. TRU-05 allows users to securely review their transaction history, and TRU-06 notifies users of insufficient funds before processing withdrawals. YOU ARE THE ORCHESTRATOR AGENT. The negotiation has ended. Integrate the outcome
into the final requirement set, organised as a KAOS goal model with three levels
(strategic, tactical, operational). Rules:
- Base every decision on the initial requirements and on the negotiation transcript above.
- Every final requirement lists in "derived_from" the IDs of the initial requirements it keeps,
  merges or refines. A final requirement may derive from several agents' requirements.
- Every initial requirement that is not represented in any "derived_from" goes into "dropped".
- Account for EVERY initial requirement: "decisions" has exactly one entry per initial ID
  (SAF-01, SAF-02, SAF-03, SAF-04, SAF-05, SAF-06, SAF-07, EFF-01, EFF-02, EFF-03, EFF-04, EFF-05, EFF-06, EFF-07, GRN-01, GRN-02, GRN-03, GRN-04, GRN-05, GRN-06, GRN-07, TRU-01, TRU-02, TRU-03, TRU-04, TRU-05, TRU-06, TRU-07, RES-01, RES-02, RES-03, RES-04, RES-05, RES-06, RES-07), with "fate" "kept" (the final requirement "final" includes it in "derived_from")
  or "dropped" ("final" is null). Do not silently omit any initial requirement.
- For every conflict raised in the negotiation, record how it was resolved: outcome is one of
  "merged", "decomposed", "favored" (one agent's constraint prevails) or "unresolved";
  "favored_agent" names the prevailing agent or is null.
- Final requirement text: one "shall" statement, at most 40 words. "parent" is the id of a
  final requirement one level above, or null for strategic goals.

      "parent": "F-01"
    },
    {
      "id": "F-06",
      "text": "The system shall provide a mechanism for safe degradation by allowing limited withdrawals during system maintenance.",
      "quality_axes": ["Safety|Efficiency|Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["SAF-06", "GRN-06"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": "F-01"
    },
    {
      "id": "F-07",
      "text": "The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.",
      "quality_axes": ["Safety|Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["SAF-07"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": "F-01"
    },
    {
      "id": "F-08",
      "text": "The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.",
      "quality_axes": ["Efficiency"],
      "derived_from": ["EFF-01"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-09",
      "text": "The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.",
      "quality_axes": ["Efficiency"],
      "derived_from": ["EFF-02"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "text": "The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.",
      "quality_axes": ["Efficiency"],
      "derived_from": ["EFF-03"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "text": "The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.",
      "quality_axes": ["Efficiency|Safety"],
      "derived_from": ["EFF-06"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-12",
      "text": "The ATM system shall implement load balancing to manage transaction requests effectively.",
      "quality_axes": ["Efficiency"],
      "derived_from": ["EFF-07"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-13",
      "text": "The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing to reduce idle states.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability|Efficiency"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-01"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-14",
      "text": "The ATM system shall provide a carbon footprint report for each transaction executed.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-02"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-15",
      "text": "The ATM system shall utilize energy-efficient hardware components to operate.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-03"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-16",
      "text": "The ATM system shall ensure that all recorded transactions are logged in a way that minimizes data storage requirements.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-04"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-17",
      "text": "The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-05"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-18",
      "text": "The ATM system shall automatically shut down during periods of inactivity to save energy.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-06"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-19",
      "text": "The ATM system shall assess the environmental impact of its operations annually and report findings to stakeholders.",
      "quality_axes": ["Sustainability"],
      "derived_from": ["GRN-07"],
      "kaos_level": "strategic",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-20",
      "text": "The system shall ensure that all transactions are encrypted during transmission.",
      "quality_axes": ["Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["TRU-01"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-21",
      "text": "The system shall provide a mechanism for users to review their transaction history securely.",
      "quality_axes": ["Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["TRU-05"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-22",
      "text": "The system shall maintain data integrity by validating all account operations against business rules.",
      "quality_axes": ["Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["TRU-07"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-23",
      "text": "The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.",
      "quality_axes": ["Responsibility"],
      "derived_from": ["RES-01"],
      "kaos_level": "strategic",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-24",
      "text": "The application shall provide transaction logs that include date, time, type, amount, and updated balance.",
      "quality_axes": ["Responsibility|Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["RES-02"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-25",
      "text": "The application shall validate user identity through a secure PIN entry mechanism.",
      "quality_axes": ["Responsibility|Trustworthiness"],
      "derived_from": ["RES-04"],
      "kaos_level": "tactical",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-26",
      "text": "The application shall notify users immediately if a transaction cannot be completed due to insufficient funds.",
      "quality_axes": ["Responsibility|Safety"],
      "derived_from": ["RES-06"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    },
    {
      "id": "F-27",
      "text": "The system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account only when sufficient funds are available.",
      "quality_axes": ["Responsibility|Safety"],
      "derived_from": ["RES-05"],
      "kaos_level": "operational",
      "parent": null
    }
  ],
